condition.drop_percent: price drops by at least {percent}% from the start

reason.below_price: at or below your threshold of {amount}
reason.below_typical: below the typical route price of {amount}

found.baggage_unknown: Price without baggage: the source doesn't know its terms — check with the seller.

drop.previous: Last time we wrote about {previous}: now {diff} cheaper.
drop.note_html: Price from search history: the seller confirms the final one.
drop.subject: Price dropped: {route}

confirm.subject: Confirm your price alert

commands.link: Link to your account on the website

bot.confirmed_html: ✅ Alert confirmed {route} Condition: {condition}. I'll write as soon as the price drops.
bot.linked_html: 🔗 Telegram is linked to the account @{username}. Alerts from this chat are now visible in your account on the website.
bot.inactive: This alert is no longer active.
bot.new_threshold_html: New threshold for {route} — price {party} in {currency}, e.g. 90.
bot.new_html: ➕ New alert Where are we flying from? Type a city or an airport code, e.g. London or LON.
bot.return_before: The return can't be before the departure.
bot.amount_hint_html: Type the amount as a number, e.g. 120, or press “Below typical”.
bot.not_found: Couldn't find “{text}”. Try a city name in English or Ukrainian, or a three-letter airport code.
bot.same_city: The destination must be different. Where to?
bot.ask_threshold_html: When should I notify you? Type a price threshold per adult in EUR (e.g. 120) or choose “Below typical” — when the price is 10% below the usual one for the route.
bot.typical_edit: To switch to “below typical”, create a new alert: /new
bot.create_failed: Couldn't create the alert. Try again: /new
bot.no_history: There are no prices for these dates in search history yet — I'll check several times a day.
bot.welcome_html: 👋 Hi! I'm the SkyPack bot. I watch flight prices and write as soon as a price drops below your threshold or below the usual one for the route. • /new — new alert (from, to, date, threshold) • /list — your alerts • /link — link to your account on the website You can also subscribe on the website: the “Watch the price” button on search results.
bot.help_html: What I can do /new — new price alert /list — my alerts (turn off, change threshold) /stop — turn off all alerts /link — link to your account on the website /cancel — cancel the current action
bot.link_help_html: 🔗 To link Telegram to your account, open Account → Sign-in and security → Telegram on the website and press “Link Telegram”. Alerts from this chat will then appear in your account.
bot.bad_date: I didn't understand the date. Type, for example, 05.12 or 2026-12-05 (not in the past).
bot.unknown_link: The link is outdated or already used. Create a new one on the website.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.email:
To link this address to your SkyPack account, open the link: {link}
The link is valid for 24 hours. If it wasn't you, ignore this email.

reset.subject: Password reset
reset.email:
To set a new password, open the link (valid for 1 hour): {link}
If you didn't ask for a reset, ignore this email — your password won't change.
